effect_description_eng:
＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
＜Reboot＞ (This Digimon also unsuspends in your opponent's unsuspend phase.)
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] This Digimon may battle 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By trashing 2 bottom face-down cards from under any of your Tamers, you may play or use 1 play or use cost 6 or lower [Glowing Dawn] trait card from your hand or your Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.
xros_req:
[Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Glowing Dawn] trait: Cost 4
[Digivolve] [Atratusmon] w/o play cost: Cost 2
Assembly Requirements [Assembly -5] Lv.5 × Lv.4 × Lv.3, all w/[Glowing Dawn] trait
When this would be played, by placing the specified cards from the trash under it, reduce the play cost.
